text: Shemagh Al Bassam is the shemagh brand and store of Mohammed Al-Saad Al-Ajlan Sons Co. (شركة أبناء محمد السعد العجلان, named in the site footer); its FAQ says the shemaghs come from the company's own factories.
short: Shemagh Al Bassam belongs to Mohammed Al-Saad Al-Ajlan Sons Co.

source.name: Shemagh Al Bassam store (alajlanonline.com): FAQ
source.note: The archived page's footer names the store operator as شركة أبناء محمد السعد العجلان (Mohammed Al-Saad Al-Ajlan Sons Co.), and its FAQ says Al-Bassam shemaghs are made in the company's own factories in Britain and Riyadh. The live page blocks scripts (403); archived copy of 2026-04-06 used.
